open_items.text: Financial Project ID: no project source gives it
Bridge number: no project source gives it (blank on the generated FDOT sheets)
unit costs and the total construction cost are not in the project record
construction time requirement not in the project record

Environmental classification (SDG 1.4) for covers, pile minimum size and strand tension limits: pending in every registered calculation (A-011); the beam runs assume 'Moderately' aggressive. Bridge Corrosion Environment Report required (FDM 121.10).

FDM 121.9 / 121.10: the Phase I Geotechnical Report accompanies the BDR. The record holds the FB-MultiPier soil profiles of the registered exports, the 18-ton downdrag given by the geotechnical engineer (D-050) and the four longitudinal sections prepared for the geotechnical engineer; no borings, minimum tip elevations or scour values.

Deck drainage and the Bridge Hydraulics Report / Recommendation Sheet (FDM 121.10): the structure is a grade separation; concurrence that no BHR is required, and the deck drainage scheme, are not in the record.
FDM 121.10 checklist item: existing and proposed utilities in the vicinity and any attachments are not in the record.
FDM 121.10 checklist item: lighting on or under the structure is not in the record.
FDM 121.10 checklist item: not addressed in the record.

The project record documents the selected two-span, two-beam FIB-36 layout and the superseded three-beam layout (journal archive modules). A comparison of other viable superstructure and substructure types with costs, if the District requires one for this Category 1 structure, is not in the record.
FDM 121.9.1(5) requires a statement on the feasibility of GRS abutments. The project record has no GRS assessment; the end bents are pile-supported caps within MSE walls.

FDM 121.9.1(9): the superstructure beams and the end-bent piles are prestressed precast elements and the pier piles are steel pipe; the deck, caps, backwalls, cheek walls and pier wall are cast in place. A feasibility assessment of further prefabrication (FDM 121.19 questions, assessment matrix, direct and indirect costs) is not in the record.
FDM 121.10 checklist item: lighting on or under the structure is not in the record.
Phase I Geotechnical Report with borings, minimum tip elevations (SDG 3.5.9), test-pile or pile-order lengths, downdrag documentation and the pipe-pile driving limit (FDM 121.10).
Scour: concurrence that the grade separation has no scour design (Pile Data Table columns K to O) from the drainage and geotechnical engineers.
Environment classification and the corrosion allowance of the pipe piles (A-011).
Drivability and driving stresses (LRFD 10.7.8, Spec. 455) and the pile-to-cap connection with 12-in embedment (SDG 3.5.1.C, SDM 11.6).
Final FB-MultiPier reruns with the pile heads at the notebook cutoffs (COH-028) and the complete load comparison (COH-004).
FDM 121.9.1(5) requires a statement on the feasibility of GRS abutments. The project record has no GRS assessment; the end bents are pile-supported caps within MSE walls.

FDM 121.9.1(13) and FDM 262: MSE walls A1 to A8 and B1 to B9 retain the approach ramps; the wall study (wall type selection, control drawings) is not in the record. The record holds the wall geometry (CAD), the MSE exclusion-zone check (C015) and the backwall tie-back basis (C014).

FDM 121.9.1(8) and FDM 240: the bridge spans I-95, so beam erection, pile driving at the pier and falsework-free deck construction over live traffic must be shown with lane closures, stability tower locations and user-impact comparison. No TTC plan is in the record.
FDM 121.9.2: construction time requirements and the effect of site constraints on them are not in the record.
FDM 121.9.3: the District establishes the level of aesthetics. Pedestrian bridges are named among the sites where aesthetics may play a more important role (121.9.3(1)(c)).
FDM 121.9.3(2): an estimate of the cost to implement the recommended aesthetic treatments.

FDM 121.9.1(11): unit costs from the BDR Estimating Section of the Structures Manual (Long Range Estimating) are not in the record; the quantity table below carries blank unit-cost and amount columns.
Cost curves (FDM 121.9.1(12)): with a single viable span arrangement (median pier) no span-arrangement cost curve was developed; a statement to that effect, or the curve, is required.
Total estimated construction cost of the recommended design (FDM 121.9.8).
